# Ascension perks — synthetic fixture

# Tier 0 — no prerequisites
ap_one_vision = {
	tier = 0
	modifier = {
		pop_government_ethic_attraction = 0.15
		council_agenda_progress_speed = 0.20
	}
	potential = {
		NOT = { has_ascension_perk = ap_one_vision }
	}
	possible = { always = yes }
	on_enabled = { }
	ai_weight = { weight = 1 }
}

ap_executive_vigor = {
	tier = 0
	modifier = { country_edict_cap_add = 1 }
	potential = {
		NOT = { has_ascension_perk = ap_executive_vigor }
	}
	possible = { always = yes }
	on_enabled = { }
	ai_weight = { weight = 1 }
}

# Tier 1 — require 1 perk each
ap_mastery_of_nature = {
	tier = 1
	required_perks = { ap_one_vision }
	modifier = {
		planet_clearance_chance_mult = 0.50
		max_districts_add = 2
	}
	potential = {
		NOT = { has_ascension_perk = ap_mastery_of_nature }
		has_ascension_perk = ap_one_vision
	}
	possible = { always = yes }
	on_enabled = { }
	ai_weight = { weight = 1 }
}

ap_technological_mastery = {
	tier = 1
	required_perks = { ap_executive_vigor }
	modifier = { all_technology_research_speed = 0.10 }
	potential = {
		NOT = { has_ascension_perk = ap_technological_mastery }
		has_ascension_perk = ap_executive_vigor
	}
	possible = { always = yes }
	on_enabled = { }
	ai_weight = { weight = 1 }
}

# Tier 2 — require 2 perks, with mutual exclusion
ap_evolutionary_mastery = {
	tier = 2
	required_traditions = 3
	required_perks = { ap_mastery_of_nature ap_technological_mastery }
	excluded_perks = { ap_synthetic_evolution }
	modifier = { bio_pop_growth_speed = 0.20 }
	potential = {
		NOT = { has_ascension_perk = ap_evolutionary_mastery }
		NOT = { has_ascension_perk = ap_synthetic_evolution }
	}
	possible = {
		NOT = { has_ethic = ethic_gestalt_consciousness }
	}
	on_enabled = { }
	ai_weight = { weight = 1 }
}

ap_synthetic_evolution = {
	tier = 2
	required_traditions = 4
	required_perks = { ap_technological_mastery }
	excluded_perks = { ap_evolutionary_mastery }
	modifier = { pop_robotic_production_mult = 0.15 }
	potential = {
		NOT = { has_ascension_perk = ap_synthetic_evolution }
		NOT = { has_ascension_perk = ap_evolutionary_mastery }
		has_tradition = tr_expansion_finish
	}
	possible = {
		NOT = { has_ethic = ethic_gestalt_consciousness }
		has_technology = tech_neural_implants
	}
	on_enabled = { }
	ai_weight = { weight = 1 }
}
